headline: Review of FY27 budget, salary schedules, maintenance plans, candidate interviews for Assistant Executive Director, and housing program approvals.
summary: The meeting covers the FY27 budget, salary schedules, and extraordinary maintenance schedule, along with interviews of two candidates for Assistant Executive Director. It also includes review of flat rent and payment standards, a furnace replacement work order, and a ramp construction quote for 7-8 Arthur St.
